title: Towards a Resilience-Theoretic Foundation for Adversarial Robustness in Industrial Control System Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2609.07244v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Anomaly-based intrusion detection systems in industrial control systems (ICS) and operational technology (OT) environments are increasingly required to meet formal resilience criteria: absorbed adversarial disturbances, graceful degradation under sustained attack, and certified system-level guarantees. translated_title: 迈向工业控制系统异常检测中对抗鲁棒性的弹性理论基础
translated_abstract: 工业控制系统（ICS）和运营技术（OT）环境中基于异常的入侵检测系统日益需要满足正式的弹性准则：吸收对抗性扰动、在持续攻击下实现优雅降级，以及获得认证的系统级保证。现有的网络物理系统弹性框架在架构层面定义了吸收-恢复-适应轨迹，但并未将机器学习异常检测器视为一等组件，导致组件级鲁棒性评估与系统级弹性认证之间存在差距。本文确立了工业控制系统异常检测中的对抗鲁棒性是系统弹性的一种特定实例化，并通过将四个弹性构念——即扰动类别、吸收能力、恢复轨迹和降级函数——映射到对抗机器学习设置中来形式化这一联系。
tldr: 本文首次将工业控制系统异常检测中的对抗鲁棒性形式化为系统弹性的一种具体实例，通过将扰动类别、吸收能力、恢复轨迹和降级函数四个弹性构念映射到对抗机器学习设置中，弥合了组件级鲁棒性评估与系统级弹性认证之间的差距。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes adversarial robustness in ICS anomaly detection as a specific instantiation of system resilience, formalizing the connection by mapping four resilience constructs—disturbance class, absorption capacity, recovery trajectory, and degradation function—onto the adversarial machine learning setting, thereby bridging the gap between component-level robustness evaluation and system-level resilience certification.
